title: ResearchLog
description: A documented research investigation, capturing every search performed (including searches that found nothing) so researchers can avoid duplicating work and document a 'reasonably exhaustive search' per the Genealogical Proof Standard. ID comes from the map key in the parent structure.

title.description: Optional human-readable title (e.g., 'Locate Jane Webb in 1860 census')

subject.description: Optional typed reference to the entity being investigated (person, event, relationship, or place)

date.description: Date the research was performed or session started (GLX date format)

researcher.description: Name or identifier of the researcher who performed the work

objective.description: Research question or goal (e.g., 'Locate Jane Webb in 1860 census to confirm birthplace')

searches.description: Individual search attempts made for this research log

source.description: Reference to the Source searched (when known to the archive)

collection.description: Free-form collection name (used when no Source entity exists yet, e.g., 'United States, Census, 1860')

date.description: Date this specific search was performed

result.description: Outcome of the search (validated against search_result_types vocabulary)

citation.description: Reference to the Citation produced when result is 'found'

notes.description: Free-form notes about this specific search attempt

leads.description: Competing hypotheses under investigation (e.g., candidate parents in a brick-wall search), each with evidence for and against, a status, and next steps

description.description: Brief description of the hypothesis (e.g., 'John H. Green of Wheeling, VA')

persons.description: Candidate Person entities this lead is about

status.description: Lead status (validated against lead_statuses vocabulary: active, eliminated, confirmed)

confidence.description: Researcher's confidence in the hypothesis (validated against confidence_levels vocabulary)

evidence_for.description: Free-text summaries of evidence supporting the hypothesis

evidence_against.description: Free-text summaries of evidence contradicting the hypothesis

citations.description: Citations that bear on this lead

assertions.description: Assertions that model this hypothesis (e.g., a speculative parent_child assertion)

next_steps.description: Actionable next steps for pursuing this lead

citations.description: Citations produced by this research log (denormalized from per-search citation refs for easy roll-up)

conclusions.description: Summary of findings drawn from this research

notes.description: Free-form notes about the research log
